title: Cache-warm countdown with the price of replying now vs later
what: 'Soon' line 'cache warm 41:12 (1h TTL)'; at T-5 min while a question/permission is pending or the session is idle: 'cache cold in 4:12 - reply now ~$0.09, later ~$1.72 (re-cache 172k tokens)'. Silent when the user has been away > 2 h (C026 takes over).
trigger: prompt_cache.warm && expires_at-now <= 300 s && no turn running && (permission_pending || AskUserQuestion/ExitPlanMode pending || idle > 60 s). Now = ctx x cache_read; later = recache_tokens_if_cold (else ctx) x cache_write(1h|5m). Fallback: last_line_at_ms + agg.observed_ttl. Once per expiry window; retires when expires_at passes or an API call arrives.
data_sources: ~/.cctop/status/<sid>.json prompt_cache.{warm,ttl,expires_at,recache_tokens_if_cold} (shim writes, status.rs does not parse - UNS-13); in State: last_line_at_ms, agg.observed_ttl, context size, permission_pending, pricing.toml; PreModelSwitch.cache_ttl hook (not installed).
user_action: Send the pending reply or a one-word keep-alive before the countdown ends; if the task is finished, /clear with a hand-off note instead of going cold.
lever: cold cache (turns A02 from post-mortem into prevention)
benefit_estimate: 49 cold restarts after > 1 h gaps re-wrote 10.0M cache-creation tokens (median 183k); cold calls are 1.8% of calls but 14.6% of spend (~$139); a keep-alive costs ~5% of the rebuild it prevents ($0.45 vs $8.72 at 894k ctx). ~7 prompts/month land in the 45-65 min window; each catch is $0.9-8.
false_positive_risk: Medium: shim reported ttl 5m while transcripts behave like 1 h (49/49 gaps > 60 min cold, 1/53 at 15-60 min) - prefer expires_at, log disagreement; status file only rewrites on Claude Code redraws so the countdown must be clock-driven; keep-alive advice is wrong if the user will not return within the TTL.
evidence_refs: src: TS-01, COACH-03, BO-11(countdown), RW-C19(countdown) | RW-09; T06; PH-12; SUG-IDLE-CACHE; UNS-13; UNS-10; RULE-A02; S02; C06; F01; BIN-13; BIN-25; E11

title: Switch window: warn before /model, /effort, /fast while warm; say when a switch is free
what: Warm: 'Switching to sonnet now re-reads 134k tokens uncached (~$0.40) - cache goes cold in 38 min anyway; switch then, right after /clear, or at the next checkpoint'. Cold/boundary (plan exit, /clear, resume, first prompt): 'cache is cold - a /model or /effort change is free right now; set /effort high s and leave it until the next /clear'. Says 'decide now', never which effort is right.
trigger: Warm: PreModelSwitch with prompt_cache_warm=true and context_tokens > 100k, or a new history.jsonl line for this project starting with /model|/effort|/fast while State says warm and ctx > 100k (<command-name> lines confirm after the fact). Cold: expires_at passed (or > TTL since last call) or ExitPlanMode/plan_mode_exit/SessionStart.source in {clear,resume,compact}/first prompt, AND history.jsonl shows >= 3 /model|/effort uses in this project. Retires when the cache warms or the command lands.
data_sources: PreModelSwitch/PostModelSwitch {from_model,to_model,context_tokens,prompt_cache_warm,cache_ttl,estimated_cache_write_usd} (hooks.rs EVENTS lacks both); ~/.claude/history.jsonl {display,project,timestamp} (not read); user <command-name> lines (T12, unparsed); plan_mode_exit attachment / ExitPlanMode result; status prompt_cache.warm/expires_at (unparsed); settings effortLevel/modelSettings (unread); State ctx + observed TTL.
user_action: Defer the switch until the cache is cold or the context is cleared; make model/effort choices at boundaries; use 'ultrathink' in one prompt for a hard step instead of a mid-task /effort change.
benefit_estimate: /model is the most used slash command (75 lifetime; 22/month in the corpus); 10 of 10 mid-session model switches were fully cold; up to 487k tokens / $4.63 per switch; fast-mode toggle re-reads the whole context at fast rates; after plan exit the next turn adds p50 29.9k on already-read files.
timing: before turn (at the command) / task boundary (free-window hint)
false_positive_risk: Low for the warning (exact command + warm flag); effort changes on Fable 5.1 (2.1.260+) keep the cache - gate on model; a model-specific weekly limit hit legitimately forces a switch; PreModelSwitch needs cctop install (30 s budget); the cold hint only helps users with a switching habit.
evidence_refs: src: TS-03, BO-09(switch), COACH-09(cold) | E12; H13; C07; E05; PH-12; PH-07; SUG-IDLE-CACHE; HS-06; HS-13; T12; T13; P22; P24; F16

title: $ per call at the current context and the cost of continuing, escalating above 300k/400k
what: 'ctx 420k · $0.23/call · ~$2.6/turn (vs $0.41 at < 100k) · next 30 calls ~ $6.3'. Escalating line when the turn ended cleanly: quiet < 200k, visible 200-400k, insistent > 400k: 'let this run finish, then /clear or hand off (fresh prefix ~50k): turns cost ~$2.6 each vs ~$0.4 after'. Re-fires at each +100k.
trigger: Every tick: cost/call = ctx x cache_read + median output x output price; cost/turn = x median API calls/turn; projection = p50 calls per long run (32). Escalate when ctx > 300k (insistent > 400k on 1M windows) AND last turn ended in text AND no pending background tasks. Retires when ctx drops. Distinct from A06 (velocity) and A18 (3 h timer).
data_sources: agg turns (ctx per call, api_calls, output) + pricing (in State); status context_window.current_usage (unparsed); Stop.background_tasks (spooled, unread) and turn_duration.pendingBackgroundAgentCount (unparsed) for the clean-ending condition.
user_action: /compact <focus> or /clear at the next checkpoint; write a 5-line hand-off note and start fresh.
lever: context volume x re-read multiplier (largest single cost driver)
benefit_estimate: Calls above 300k ctx are 26.5% of calls but 53.6% of spend ($0.23-0.50/call vs $0.07-0.10); per turn $2.63-7.32 vs $0.41-0.97; cache-read cost of context above 300k = $176/month (18.5%); top 5% of turns (ctx p50 472k, 30 calls) are 42% of billed input; ~6 sessions/month exceed 400k, two ran to 921k/953k uncompacted.
false_positive_risk: Low: numbers are exact; 1M-window users may keep context deliberately; /clear discards state; subscribers see limit weight rather than $ (C024).
evidence_refs: src: TS-05, COACH-14(main) | T12; T01; T11; PH-11; PH-14; SUG-COMMIT-BOUNDARY; PH-07; RW-16; RULE-A18; RULE-A06; BIN-03; P12; P19

title: Context tax annotation on every large result and tool input
what: Tools 'top ctx' line, detail overlay and a transient coach line: 'Read src/x.rs: 12k tokens, re-read ~100x (~$0.30 over the rest of the session)' -> 'Read with offset/limit or grep first'; Advisor 'tokens saved' ranked by token-calls (tokens x expected remaining calls) so early bloat outranks late one-offs.
trigger: Any tool result or tool_use input >= 1.8k tokens (top-5% threshold); remaining calls = max(baseline median calls/session - calls so far, 10) (corpus median 43); LATER class, dies after 3 calls.
data_sources: tools.calls.result_tokens_est, baseline (7-day medians), pricing (in State); tool_use input size needs input_tokens_est from C013.
user_action: Narrow the command (head/grep, Read offset+limit) before more rounds; treat context added early as far costlier than late.
benefit_estimate: Each token added is re-read ~106x; 1k tokens mid-session costs $0.0144 median ($0.022 p75) more in cache reads; top 5% of results (>= 1.8k, n=312) hold 44% of tool-result tokens; a 5k result mid-session costs $0.072 median (up to $0.66); cache reads are 66% of spend. A03 fires session-lifetime on > 3k and never shows marginal cost.
false_positive_risk: Low-medium: remaining-call estimate is noisy (label ~); a large Read of the file about to be edited is legitimate; compaction/clear voids the tax; subscribers do not pay per token.
evidence_refs: src: TS-06, COACH-05(a) | T01; T04; RULE-A03; RULE-ENGINE

title: Verification-gap timer: edited files, no check yet
what: Strip number 'edits 3 ✓never' / '✓12m', amber after 10 min or 14 calls since the first edit of the turn with no verify call. Nudge at amber and turn end: 'Edited 3 files, no test/build run this turn - queue: run <detected test cmd> and fix failures before you stop'. Test cmd = last successful verify-class Bash command in the session or the CLAUDE.md test line; queued prompts are absorbed mid-turn so no Esc is needed.
trigger: First Edit/Write/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit or Bash implement sets first_edit_at/edits_since_verify; any verify-class call (C055: cargo test|build|check|clippy, npm|pnpm|bun test|run build|lint, pytest, go test|build, make, tsc, eslint/ruff/mypy, vitest/jest, curl localhost), a screenshot tool, a Skill review, or a re-read of a just-edited path resets last_verify_at. Amber when now - first_edit_at > 10 min OR calls since first edit >= 14 (p90 of verified episodes) with no verify; fire at turn end (turn_duration / Stop) with edits_since_verify > 0 on source files; strengthen when Stop.last_assistant_message says done/complete/should work. Retires on the next verify call or human prompt.
data_sources: tools.calls (name, file_path, Bash command - widen the 30-char input_summary), C055, system turn_duration (parsed), Stop payload incl. last_assistant_message (spooled, unread), toolUseResult.stderr / returnCodeInterpretation / is_error for pass/fail (raw Value). New Turn fields first_edit_at, last_verify_at, edits_since_verify, files_edited.
user_action: Queue one line while Claude works: 'run cargo test and fix failures before stopping' (Enter without Esc), or add the test command to CLAUDE.md / set /goal '<cmd> passes'.
benefit_estimate: 35% of 465 implement episodes (165) were never checked before a commit or session end; 37 waited > 10 min; verified ones reached a check in p50 2 calls / 31 s; 32% of commits had no check in the previous 10 calls. Docs/Cherny: a check Claude can run gives '2-3x the quality'. Each caught defect avoids >= 1 correction turn (median $0.49, p90 $3.47); verify calls are the cheapest phase per API call (1,590 tokens).
false_positive_risk: Medium: docs/config-only edits (.md is 4 of the 6 most-churned files) - suppress when every edited path is .md/.txt/.json/.yaml/.toml; write+run Bash commands are ambiguous (~25% confusion) - label VERIFYING so the nudge errs to silence; Ralph loops test inside subagents - suppress in bot loops (C058).
evidence_refs: src: BO-01, RW-C08, COACH-06 | PH-13; SUG-IMPLEMENT-VERIFY; PH-04; PH-05; PH-02; P01; P06; RW-06; RW-17; T12(anatomy); T08; H07; E15; UNS-11

title: Commit or PR without a check in the last 10 calls (or right after a failing one)
what: 'Committing without a check - the last 10 calls edited src/x.rs and src/y.rs but ran no test/build. Esc, then: run the tests first'. Escalated: 'Committing 2 calls after a FAILING check (cargo test exit 101)'. Retires after the next verify call or when the commit result lands.
trigger: Bash tool_use matching git commit|git push|gh pr create|gh pr merge (or toolUseResult.gitOperation.commit/push/pr) AND no verify-class call succeeded in the previous 10 calls AND >= 1 edit among them; escalate if the latest verify result has is_error / non-zero exit within the previous 3 calls. One-shot per commit; pre-emptive from PreToolUse (~1 s before the transcript line).
data_sources: tools.calls (Bash command - widen input_summary), toolUseResult.gitOperation {commit{sha,kind}, push{branch}, pr{action,number,url}} (parsed, unconsumed - T07), is_error (in State), C055, bashEditDiff/gitOperation for the diff's file list; PreToolUse tool_input (hooks.rs strips it - keep a bounded command summary); OTel vcs.* on 2.1.269.
user_action: Press Esc (the commit has not run yet when fired from PreToolUse) and reply 'run the tests first, then commit'; or install a PreToolUse hook on Bash(git commit:*) that runs the suite.
benefit_estimate: 175 of 548 commit calls (32%) had no verify in the preceding 10 calls; 5 commits followed a failing verify. Each unverified commit that breaks costs a fix turn plus a re-commit (git plumbing failures dominate Bash failures: 58 git + 54 gh errors/month); commits happen every ~2 turns so it fires often (~180/month) but cheaply; gives A18 its missing commit-boundary input.
false_positive_risk: Low-medium: docs/PRD, --amend and WIP commits legitimately skip tests - suppress when all edited paths since the last commit are non-code; git status/diff after edits counts as a light verify (160 cases) so require test/build class for the escalated wording; suppress in bot loops; read-only cctop cannot block the call.
evidence_refs: src: BO-02, RW-C09(rule), COACH-07 | PH-13; PH-04; SUG-COMMIT-BOUNDARY; RW-05; RW-07; T07; T08; P31; P05; R02

title: Uncommitted-work line: lines changed, edits and minutes since the last commit
what: Files panel line 'uncommitted: +412/-87 across 9 files · last commit 42 min / 18 edits ago' from gitOperation results and numstat; feeds C031/C040/C043 and the hand-off decision.
trigger: Recomputed on every gitOperation.commit/push result and every Edit/Write; numstat already refreshed by git.rs.
data_sources: toolUseResult.gitOperation {commit{sha}, push, pr} (parsed, unconsumed - T07/RW-07), git.rs numstat + dirty flag (in State), tools.calls edit counts, gitBranch per transcript line (GAP-06).
user_action: Commit at a green check before the diff grows; judge how much a rewind or a bad commit would put at risk.
benefit_estimate: 222 git operations/month are parsed and never consumed; commits happen every ~2 turns; a visible 'N edits since last commit' counter is the cheapest prompt for the checkpoint habit the docs recommend.
false_positive_risk: Low: exact fields; empty outside a git repo.
evidence_refs: split from RW-C09 (Files-panel line) | RW-07; T07; GAP-06; SUG-COMMIT-BOUNDARY

title: Feature-sized prompt with plan mode off (and spec-first for very large ones)
what: Pre-turn banner: 'Feature-sized request (2 paths named, 640 chars) with plan mode off - Shift+Tab to plan first; multi-file/unfamiliar changes are where wrong-approach rework starts'. Variant for prompts > 1.5k chars with no AskUserQuestion earlier: 'Big feature: ask Claude to interview you (AskUserQuestion) and write SPEC.md, then implement in a fresh session'. Once per prompt, never a toast.
trigger: User line with promptSource in {typed, suggestion_accepted}, text >= 300 chars OR >= 2 distinct path/identifier tokens, AND an implementation verb (implement|add|refactor|migrate|redesign|build|rewrite), AND latest permission-mode != plan, AND no plan_mode/plan_mode_exit attachment or ExitPlanMode this session, AND no Edit/Write yet in this turn. Shape features only, in memory. Suppressed for slash commands, <command-name> wrappers, origin.kind != human, bot loops.
data_sources: user line (text scanned in memory, promptSource, permissionMode), permission-mode lines (parsed, unused by rules), attachment plan_mode/plan_mode_exit {planFilePath, planExists} (T27, HS-07), ExitPlanMode tool_use, ~/.claude/plans/<slug>.md via the transcript slug, BaseHookInput.permission_mode (spooled, unread).
user_action: Shift+Tab twice (plan mode) before Claude starts editing, or prefix 'plan first, then implement'; for very large features run interview -> SPEC.md -> fresh session.
benefit_estimate: Plan mode used in 8 of 753 turns; 90% of permission-mode lines are auto; wrong_approach is the top /insights friction (13 counts in 11 of 40 sessions) and docs name plan mode as the fix; a rejected direction after a 6-30 tool turn costs p50 4.5 min and ~$1; fires ~10x/month (turns with >= 10 edits).
timing: before turn (as the prompt line lands)
false_positive_risk: Medium-high if keyed on length alone (p90 prompt 1,244 chars, many pasted loop instructions) - require the path/verb conjunction; sample too small to prove plan mode reduces churn, so phrase as a suggestion.

title: No verification target in the prompt
what: Pre-turn one-liner: 'No way to verify in this request - add a test name, expected output, or take-a-screenshot-and-compare (queue it now; Claude reads queued text at its next API call)'. Ready suffix: 'When done, run <detected test cmd> and report the result'.
trigger: Typed human prompt (promptSource typed|suggestion_accepted, origin.kind human) with an implementation/bug verb (implement|add|fix|build|refactor|migrate|make it|bug|broken|fails) AND none of test|spec|expect|should|assert|screenshot|verify|compare|exit 0|passes|green AND no @-mention attachment in the turn AND >= 40 chars. Once per prompt; boolean flag on the Turn, never the text.
data_sources: user line text (regex in memory), promptSource/origin (T13), attachment file/directory lines (@-mentions), queue-operation lines confirming the queued follow-up was absorbed (T17), detected test cmd from C055 history.
user_action: Queue one line with the acceptance check ('...and run cargo test; show me failures'), or restate the prompt with the expected output.
benefit_estimate: Docs: 'When Claude can verify its own work, it catches issues before you need to request fixes'; local prompts are short (p50 85 chars, p10 13) and wrong_approach/misunderstood_request dominate friction (13+3 of 40 sessions); corrections follow long autonomous Bash turns or long prose answers, i.e. turns that started without a stated check.
false_positive_risk: Medium: exploratory/question prompts excluded by the verb gate; Ralph prompts with acceptance criteria in a referenced PRD trip it unless @-mention/path presence suppresses; keyword scoring is weak - show dim, never above evidence-based rules.

title: Correction streak (structural, not keyword) -> rewind or /clear and restate
what: After the second consecutive correction on the same task: '2 corrections in a row (Esc at call 3, then a steer) - Esc Esc -> restore to turn N (before the first attempt; that prefix is still cache-warm) and restate with what you now know, instead of correcting again'. Adds '(git handles Bash edits)' when Bash-made changes exist since turn N. Says 'correction' only when a structural proxy fired, else 'two quick re-prompts'.
trigger: Structural only: (a) user text block starting '[Request interrupted by user' (+ interruptedMessageId) followed by a short prompt; (b) queue-operation remove reason absorbed_mid_turn or queued_command origin.kind human; (c) tool_result toolDenialKind user-rejected or userFeedback; (d) optional low weight: typed prompt < 120 chars < 60 s after end_turn starting with a hard negation (no|not|wrong|stop|undo|revert|nein|nicht|falsch), only when the previous turn did not end with a question. Window 3-4 turns on an overlapping edited-file set; fire at 2; retire after a clean text-ending turn; cooldown 10 turns. Turn N from file-history-snapshot messageId.
data_sources: user lines ('[Request interrupted', interruptedMessageId - T11), queue-operation.reason (op parsed, reason ignored at usage.rs:250) + queued_command (T17), toolDenialKind/userFeedback (T27; 28 user-rejected, 5 userFeedback), file-history-snapshot messageId (parsed, unused - T16), last-prompt.leafUuid, PostToolUseFailure.is_interrupt (spooled, unread). Rewind itself is not observable (RW-08).
user_action: Esc Esc, 'Restore conversation' at the turn before the failed attempt, then one rewritten prompt with the constraint; or /rename then /clear if the attempts polluted the context.
lever: less rework / token savings (failed attempts stay out of every later call)
benefit_estimate: Keyword detection is ~90% false positive (186/673 hits, 6 real) so the rule must stay structural: 63 mid-turn steers (6x interrupts), 28 user rejections, 11 interrupts/month give ~100 correction events; wrong_approach in 11 of 40 sessions; docs: after two failed corrections a clean session 'almost always outperforms'; rewind is cache-warm and removes the failed attempt. 587 checkpoints existed and 0 rewinds were used.
false_positive_risk: Low for interrupt/steer/reject (exact markers; require content[].type text and no tool_result block); variant (d) alone is ~90% false positive - never sufficient; suppress in bot loops (C058).

title: Interruption ledger and early-steer cue
what: On every Esc: 'Turn cut after 11 calls / 6.5k output tokens (Bash) - Claude re-plans from your next message; put the correction in one line · Esc Esc restores 3 checkpointed files'. Session counter 'interruptions: N (wasted ~T output tokens)', a rework tally in the state line, and a dim 'steer window' marker during the first 5 tool calls of a turn (where 9 of 11 real interrupts fell), suppressed afterwards.
trigger: NOW class: user line with a text block starting '[Request interrupted by user' (or '... for tool use'), no tool_result block, isMeta absent; join interruptedMessageId to the assistant message.id for the running tool and output tokens; live via PostToolUseFailure.is_interrupt=true. Shown within one tick; retires on the next human prompt (median 15 s) or after 60 s. Exclude these lines from the turn counter.
data_sources: user message.content[].text, interruptedMessageId (2.1.231+; 24 lines/month), promptSource; assistant lines by message.id (usage.output_tokens, tool names - in State); file-history-delta count since the last prompt (parsed, unused); PostToolUseFailure.is_interrupt (spooled, never read; false in all 30 here so the marker is primary); session-meta user_interruptions baseline. Grep 'Request interrupted'/'is_interrupt' = 0 hits in cctop.
user_action: Type the one-line correction immediately, or Esc Esc to rewind before re-prompting; past ~5 calls, queue a steer instead of Esc (C059).
benefit_estimate: 11 interruptions in 760 turns (1.4%); each cut turn wasted 194-6,553 output tokens (one 125-call browser run: 52,874); 9 within the first 5 calls, re-prompt within 5-66 s. Main value: a clean rework signal and correct turn counting - every interrupt is counted as a new prompt by usage.rs:191 today, inflating turn metrics and A12.
timing: mid turn (on the interrupt line) and after turn (ledger)
false_positive_risk: Low: exact marker; guard against the marker inside tool_result/subagent text (4 false hits); toolUseResult.interrupted is false on all 4,595 Bash results; the line must appear within one tick and vanish on the next prompt.
evidence_refs: src: RW-C01, COACH-10, BO-05(single-interrupt note) | RW-01; T11; PH-14; UNS-11; HS-02; HS-08; E16; F02; F04; C08; P14

title: Failure cascade: three consecutive failing tool calls (windowed, not session-lifetime)
what: '3 tool calls in a row failed (gh pr view exit 8, gh pr view exit 8, git push exit 128) - Claude is retrying blind. Esc and give the missing fact, or run the command yourself'. gh/git special case: 'gh failed 10 of 12 immediate retries in your history - an auth/repo problem, not code'. Retires after the next successful call.
trigger: Three consecutive is_error results in the last 10 calls, or two consecutive failures of the same normalised command prefix (first 40 chars, cd/env stripped) with no success and no Edit/Write between, within the turn. returnCodeInterpretation 'No matches found'/'Files differ' are not failures; wait-class (until/sleep) commands excluded. Distinct from A15 (identical 30-char args, session-lifetime, >= 3, no recency).
data_sources: tools.calls is_error (in State), toolUseResult 'Error: Exit code N' and returnCodeInterpretation (parsed, unconsumed - T07/T08), Bash command text, PostToolUseFailure.error + is_interrupt (spooled, unread), OTel tool_result.error_type; Turn.tool_errors written but never read (UNS-04).
user_action: Esc, paste the one fact Claude lacks (auth, path, expected value) or run the command yourself and paste the last 20 lines.
benefit_estimate: 5.1% of 4,333 Bash calls failed; 40 consecutive failing pairs and 29 blind same-prefix retries (13 failed again; gh 10/12) per month; session-signals ships the same heuristic. Each blind retry re-injects the error (avg 1,035 chars) and burns a full call at current context (p50 153k => ~$0.1); session-meta counts 85 Command Failed across 45 sessions.
false_positive_risk: Low-medium: legitimate probes (grep no match, curl polling) excluded via interpretation and wait class; build/test retries after an edit (27 of 78 identical re-runs) - require no Edit/Write between failures; Ralph subagent loops are not in the main transcript.
evidence_refs: src: BO-06, RW-C04(rule) | RW-05; F05; F02; F04; HS-02; T07; T08; RULE-A15; UNS-04; UNS-11

title: Tool-error taxonomy column (Claude Code's six classes plus sniffly's three)
what: Tools column 'errors by class' using Claude Code's ordered substring classes (Command Failed / User Rejected / Edit Failed / File Changed / File Too Large / File Not Found / Other) plus Content Not Found, Command Timeout, Tool Not Found; per-turn breakdown in the Turn panel.
trigger: Classify each is_error tool_result by ordered substring match on lowercased result text; aggregate per tool, turn and session; compare with the session-meta tool_error_categories baseline.
data_sources: tool_result is_error + text, toolUseResult string, returnCodeInterpretation, timedOutAfterMs; PostToolUseFailure.error; OTel tool_result.error_type; session-meta tool_error_categories{} (unread - GAP-07); Turn.tool_errors never read (UNS-04).
user_action: See whether errors are auth/plumbing (Command Failed), permission (User Rejected) or stale-context (File Changed) and pick the matching fix (allow rule, constraint, stop parallel edits).
benefit_estimate: 283 tool errors/month: denials 76 (27%), Command Failed 85 across 45 sessions per session-meta; the existing tool_errors metric is a bare count per tool, so an auth loop and a stale edit look the same.
false_positive_risk: Low: fixed substring classes copied from Claude Code's own classifier.
evidence_refs: split from RW-C04 (taxonomy) | RW-05; HS-02; F02; F04; UNS-04; T08

title: Unattended long run without a completion check - set a /goal
what: 'You have been away 6 min while Claude is 24 calls into a run with no test yet and no Stop hook/goal. Set: /goal all tests in tests/ pass and git status is clean, or stop after 20 turns'. Once per long run; with an active goal show 'goal: 2 iterations, 115k tokens, met=false' instead.
trigger: Running turn with >= 20 tool calls AND >= 1 edit AND (system away_summary this turn OR Notification idle_prompt OR registry statusUpdatedAt idle > 5 min) AND no verify-class call this turn AND no goal_status/session_crons and no non-cctop Stop hook in settings.json.
data_sources: system away_summary (parsed as event; ~3 min idle), attachment goal_status {met, condition, iterations, tokens} (T36, unparsed), Notification.notification_type (spooled, unread - H09), Stop.session_crons (spooled - H07), settings.json hooks (read by install.rs), registry statusUpdatedAt (HS-16), tools.calls per turn.
user_action: Type /goal <measurable end state> with a turn cap, or install a Stop hook that runs the test suite, before walking away.
benefit_estimate: Long runs (> 20 calls) are 17% of tool turns and 54% of billed input, end in text 94% of the time, and 21 of 77 had no verify at all; the harness post's top failure mode is 'premature project completion'. A goal evaluator runs on the small model ('typically negligible') - cheap insurance on the most expensive turns.
timing: mid turn (once the user is away)
false_positive_risk: Medium: Ralph loops already have a Stop hook (hook_blocking_error 44) - suppress when any non-cctop Stop hook exists (C058); ops/browse runs (16 of the 33 most expensive turns) have nothing to test - require >= 1 edit.

title: Fresh-context review before push/PR
what: 'About to push/open a PR: +412 -87 lines across 9 files since the last review pass, none reviewed in a fresh context - run /code-review (or /simplify) first; a reviewer that did not write the code catches gaps the implementer is blind to'. Cleared once a review skill/agent runs on this branch.
trigger: Bash gh pr create|gh pr ready|git push (or gitOperation.pr.action created|ready / push) AND >= 100 changed lines since the last review marker on this branch AND no review marker: Skill commandName in {code-review, review, simplify, ultrareview, security-review}, Agent subagent_type/description matching review|verify|simplif, or attributionSkill code-review. Suppress when a verify succeeded within 10 calls and the diff < 100 lines.
data_sources: tools.calls (Bash command, Skill commandName from toolUseResult.commandName, Agent subagent_type/description), toolUseResult.gitOperation (T07/RW-07), numstat (State) / C032, pr-link lines {prNumber, prUrl} (T32), attributionSkill (T30 - code-review 787 lines observed), gitBranch per line (GAP-06).
user_action: Run /code-review (fresh subagent) or ask 'use a subagent to review the diff against the plan; report only correctness gaps' before pushing.
benefit_estimate: 385 gh pr and 127 git push Bash calls/month vs 36 Skill uses; docs: 'A fresh context improves code review since Claude won't be biased toward code it just wrote'; Claude Code's own PostToolUse tip nudges /ultrareview before push (hook_system_message 49). A review pass costs one subagent (p50 ~$0.5-2) versus a post-merge fix cycle.
timing: mid turn (at the push/PR tool_use; pre-emptive via PreToolUse) or task boundary
false_positive_risk: Medium: docs-only or tiny PRs (line threshold), Ralph loops that push per story with tests as the gate - suppress in bot loops.

title: Coach strip: phase state line plus the six numbers that stay on screen (40-60 cols)
what: 7-row view: state line, 2 rows x 3 numbers, up to 2 nudge lines, 1 'soon' line, footer. State line <= 38 chars: 'IMPLEMENTING · 3 files · no check (8m)' / 'EXPLORING x6 · +41k ctx' / 'VERIFYING · cargo test ok 12s ago' / 'COMMITTING' / 'WAITING · question 4m' / 'ANSWERING' / 'IDLE 12m', plus 'turn 14 · 3m12s', a rework tally and a dim 'steer window' marker during the first 5 tool calls. Numbers: (1) 'ctx 412k $0.21/call'; (2) 'cache 41:12' or 'cold'; (3) 'run 14c +38k'; (4) 'edits 3 ✓12m' ('✓never'); (5) '5h 62% ↻2h10'; (6) '$7.31 turn' (toggle session $). Bands: ctx 40/60% of window or 200k/400k on 1M models with threshold = window - 13,000; cache < 5 min amber; ✓ older than 10 min amber.
trigger: Always visible; recomputed on every State change. Phase from the last 5 calls: last call commit class -> COMMITTING; Task*/AskUserQuestion/ExitPlanMode -> PLANNING (+WAITING until the next user line); verify class -> VERIFYING; Edit/Write/implement -> IMPLEMENTING; read-only -> VERIFYING if git status/diff after an implement in the previous 4 or a re-read of a just-edited path, IMPLEMENTING if >= 2 implements in the previous 4, else EXPLORING with run length; Agent -> EXPLORING (delegated); browser MCP -> BROWSING; ssh/gh api/curl/kubectl -> OPS; sleep/until -> WAITING; no tool_use + text -> ANSWERING.
data_sources: In State: context size/window/ratio, agg.turns (api_calls, usage, started_at, duration_ms), tools.calls (name, started/finished, result_tokens_est, is_error, turn), rate_limits five_hour + resets_at, ledger cost per turn, observed_ttl, last_line_at_ms, permission_pending/waiting_since. New: shim prompt_cache.{expires_at, recache_tokens_if_cold, warm, ttl} (UNS-13); per-call price = ctx x cache_read; Bash class (C055); Turn.first_edit_at / last_verify_at / edits_since_verify (C030); AskUserQuestion pending; Spinner.mode from function-hooks ui.render (E21, pane only). Reference: scratchpad phases4.py coach_phase(); regression data turns.csv/segments.csv (PH-00).
user_action: Glance to decide: steer now (first 5 calls), let it run (long run, check done), or answer (WAITING); every nudge refers to one of these numbers so the evidence sits next to the advice.
lever: token savings + better outcomes (substrate for C001/C005/C012/C030/C042/C043)
benefit_estimate: Keeps the two levers behind 66% of spend visible (context re-read ~106x per token; calls above 300k are 53.6% of spend; 116 cold calls = 14.6% of spend). The phase heuristic reproduces the per-call labeler on 94.0% of 6,255 calls with zero-call latency in 93% of segments; phases are 1-6 calls long so only a per-call state line matches reality; real interrupts cluster at p50 3 calls in while long runs end well 94% of the time.
false_positive_risk: Medium on verify vs implement for write+run Bash (47-56% agreement vs the model's description) - a ~200-call hand-labelled sample is needed before trusting VERIFYING for C030/C031 escalations; cache countdown source conflict (shim 5m vs 1h behaviour - show the status value when present, else last call + 1h); ctx from transcript labelled est without the shim.

title: WAITING-ON-YOU state for questions and AskUserQuestion, with cache clock and desktop notification
what: State line 'WAITING 4m - Claude asked a question (AskUserQuestion, 2 options)' (or 'permission: Bash cargo test' / 'idle'). Nudge: 'a one-word reply is enough; cache warm for 41:12 (cold restart ~172k tokens)'. Desktop notification (alerts.rs critical() with --notify) after 30 s; repeats once when the cache clock reaches 5 min. Distinct from the existing permission-pending WAITING pill.
trigger: NOW class: AskUserQuestion/ExitPlanMode tool_use with no result, OR the last assistant text block of a finished turn ends with '?' with no pending tool_use and registry idle, OR Notification.notification_type in {idle_prompt, permission_prompt, agent_needs_input}; >= 30 s with no user line; not covered by PermissionWaitLong. Countdown = prompt_cache.expires_at else last call + observed TTL. Retires on the next user line, PostToolUse for the pending call, or away > 2 h.
data_sources: assistant text blocks (last block per turn - agg keeps usage only), AskUserQuestion tool_use/toolUseResult {questions, answers} (T39), registry status/statusUpdatedAt (HS-16), Notification.notification_type (spooled, unread - H09; permission_prompt fires in auto modes where PermissionRequest does not), prompt_cache.expires_at/recache_tokens_if_cold (UNS-13/S02), agg.last_line_at + observed_ttl (in State), alerts.rs deliver()/critical() (ALERT-01), claude agents --json waitingFor.
user_action: Answer the question or permission now (yes/no or one word), or /btw a clarifying question, instead of returning after the cache expired.
benefit_estimate: 145 of 760 turns (19%) end with a question, 53 use AskUserQuestion, 43% of replies are < 40 chars; wait after AskUserQuestion p50 213 s but mean 44 min (max 12 h) - the likeliest place for a cache-expiring idle (49/49 gaps > 60 min cold, ~190k re-cached each); the stalled task does not progress. Existing WAITING/PermissionWaitLong cover only PermissionRequest (3 events across 8 spools; 0 in auto mode).
timing: after turn (when the question lands), escalating while idle
false_positive_risk: Low for AskUserQuestion; medium for '?' (rhetorical; 6 of 74 correction prompts followed a question) - require AskUserQuestion or a Notification for the desktop alert, '?' only for the state word; idle_prompt is version/mode dependent.
evidence_refs: src: BO-11, RW-C19, COACH-12 | RW-10; PH-12; PH-15; SUG-IDLE-CACHE; T39; HS-16; H09; X02; S02; UNS-13; UNS-11; ALERT-01; RULE-A09; E13; A12; P10

title: Natural-boundary checkpoint detector, context-graded (replaces A18's timer as the coach's boundary signal)
what: Footer-level, quiet < 200k, visible 200-400k, insistent > 400k: 'checkpoint: tests green, commit 2m ago, nothing pending, ctx 312k - if the next task is unrelated: ask for a 5-line hand-off note (done / next / test cmd) -> /rename -> /clear (fresh start ~50k; $2.63 -> $0.41/turn); if related, continue'. Highest-confidence wording after TaskUpdate(completed) and question-ended turns; never claims 'task done' after a commit alone.
trigger: NEXT class at turn end: turn ended in assistant text (end_turn, no trailing '?', no AskUserQuestion pending) AND no pending background work (Stop.background_tasks empty, turn_duration.pendingBackgroundAgentCount/pendingWorkflowCount absent) AND one of: gitOperation.commit/push/pr.merged in the last 3 turns, TaskUpdate status=completed this turn, task_reminder itemCount dropped to 0, git status clean, prompt with done/next/finished. Weight TaskUpdate-completed and question-ended highest (70% / 89% new files next), commits lowest (19%). Suppressed 5 turns after firing; retires on the next human prompt or /clear (SessionStart source=clear / new transcript).
data_sources: Stop payload background_tasks/session_crons/last_assistant_message (spooled, unread - TASK-02/H07), system turn_duration.messageCount/pendingBackgroundAgentCount/pendingWorkflowCount (only durationMs parsed - T14), toolUseResult.gitOperation (T07/RW-07), TaskUpdate/TaskCreate input.status + toolUseResult.statusChange (T28), task_reminder itemCount (T28/HS-09), git.rs dirty flag (in State), stop_reason (parsed), SessionStart.source (spooled, unread), ledger $ per turn and post-/clear ctx p50 50.7k. Replaces the empty tasks.rs listing (TASK-01).
user_action: At the checkpoint: ask for a short hand-off note to NOTES.md, /rename, then /clear if the next task is unrelated; otherwise keep going.
lever: better outcomes + token savings + less rework
benefit_estimate: No single cheap signal marks task end: after a commit the next turn stays on the same files 81% of the time, whereas TaskUpdate-completed (70% new / 28.6% fully new) and question-ended turns (89% / 66.7%) mark boundaries vs 30.4% baseline; commits every ~2 turns so the line must be quiet. Calls above 300k are 53.6% of spend and a > 600k turn costs 18x a < 100k turn; the only autocompaction (567k, 80.7 s, 60% dropped) was followed by abandonment. A18 is a 3 h timer with no boundary input.
false_positive_risk: High for 'task done' (hence soft wording, ctx-graded urgency, footer not toast, no Avoids ranking); file-novelty ground truth covers 359 of 682 turns; Ralph/workflow sessions commit per story and must not be told to /clear - suppress with a non-cctop Stop hook or hook_blocking_error, and when Stop.background_tasks is non-empty (11 of 18 Stops here had tasks pending).

title: Destructive git operation by Claude: checkpoints do not cover it
what: Event + toast: 'Claude ran git stash (call 41) - rewind cannot undo Bash-made changes; check git stash list / git reflog before continuing'. Variants for reset --hard, checkout -- <path>, checkout ., restore, clean -f. Lists files changed by Bash (bashEditDiff) that a rewind would not restore.
trigger: Bash command matching git (reset --hard|checkout -- |checkout \.|restore |clean -f|stash(?! list| show)) or toolUseResult.bashEditDiff changedFiles > 0 on a non-Edit/Write path; once per occurrence, kept in Events; stash followed by stash pop in the same turn collapses to one benign pair.

false_positive_risk: Low-medium: branch navigation (checkout <branch>, switch) excluded; stash/pop pairs collapsed.

title: Rewind points available: checkpoints since turn k and what they cannot undo

title: Stale-context alerts: IDE edits, stale-read hints, stale-recovered edits, collision warning (with A04 exemption)

Avoid editing the same file while Claude is mid-edit on it' / 'Bash changed 2 files Claude had read - a re-read is coming (staleReadFileStateHint)' / 'Edit applied after the file changed under Claude (staleRecovered); if edits keep failing, ask it to re-read'. title: Bug-fix turn with no test touched (test-first ordering)

title: Denial classifier: auto-mode-blocked vs settings-denied vs user-rejected, with the exact allow rule and the auto-mode pause warning
what: Per-turn breakdown of denied calls by kind and a nudge: 'Auto mode blocked Bash 3x this turn (gh api ...) - Claude keeps retrying variants and auto mode pauses after 3 consecutive (or 20 total) blocks. Add permissions.allow Bash(gh api:*) (settings.local.json) or answer the pending prompt' (shows the classifier reason and count toward 20); settings-deny: 'Bash denied by your permission rules 2x - Claude cannot do this; tell it the alternative'; 'ExitPlanMode rejected - plan is being redone'; after auto_mode_exit: 'auto mode paused after repeated blocks - approve to resume'. Retires when a call of that prefix succeeds.
trigger: tool_result lines with toolDenialKind in {automode-blocked, automode-unavailable, permission-rule, user-rejected} (or text 'auto mode classifier' / 'denied by your permission settings' / "doesn't want to proceed"), >= 2 consecutive for one tool/command prefix or >= 3 in the turn; >= 1 permission-rule; attachment auto_mode_exit; live via PermissionDenied hook (reason) and PermissionRequest.permission_suggestions[].rules[].ruleContent. Suggested rule = Claude Code's own suggestion when present, else Bash(<argv0> <sub>:*) - never bare Bash (A09's unsafe advice); skip rules already in permissions.allow.

Every denied call is a full round-trip at current context ($0.10 at 100-300k, $0.23-0.50 above) producing nothing, usually followed by a variant retry.
timing: mid turn (on the 2nd denial of a kind) and after turn
false_positive_risk: Low: fixed strings and the toolDenialKind key; settings-denied commands are intentional so the allow-rule suggestion appears only for automode-blocked; prefix suggestions need user review.

title: Repeated correction across sessions -> CLAUDE.md line

Each persisted rule removes one correction turn ($0.49 median) from every future session in the project (median 6 turns/session).

title: Long-context instruction drift: restate constraints past 150k (and again at 300k/400k)

Restate the 3 constraints that matter in your next prompt, move them to CLAUDE.md / the plan file, or /clear at the next checkpoint'. Pairs with C043's urgency grades.

timing: before turn (at the crossing, with the next prompt)

title: Bash command phase classifier (commit / implement / verify / explore / gitread / ops / wait)

Classes: commit = git commit|push|tag|merge|rebase|add, gh pr create|merge, gh release; implement = sed -i, heredoc/redirect into a source path, mv/cp/mkdir/rm/touch, npm|cargo add; verify = cargo test|build|check|clippy|fmt|run, npm|pnpm|bun test|run|ci, npx, pytest, make, go test|build, tsc, vitest/jest, eslint/ruff/mypy, curl localhost, ./target/...; ops = ssh, gh api|run|workflow, curl, kubectl, docker, clawctl; wait = sleep/until; gitread = git status|diff|log; explore = cat/sed -n/head/tail/grep/rg/ls/find/jq/wc.
trigger: Applied to every Bash tool_use on ingest; needs the full command text (tools.rs keeps 30 chars; hooks.rs strips tool_input - keep a bounded 200-char command summary in both). Ambiguous write+run commands labelled verify so verification nudges err toward silence.
data_sources: assistant tool_use input.command (in State, clipped), PreToolUse tool_input.command (stripped, hooks.rs:75), toolUseResult.returnCodeInterpretation/gitOperation for confirmation (T07/T08), CLAUDE.md test command via prefix.rs file reads. Reference: scratchpad phases.py classify_bash/assign_phases, turns.csv, segments.csv (PH-00).
user_action: None directly - enables the dependent candidates; the user sees phase names instead of raw tool names.
benefit_estimate: Under auto mode 70% of tool calls are Bash and Grep/Glob never appear, so name-based rules (A05) fire in 4 sessions while the Bash-aware variant fires in 39; the classifier agrees with the model's own description on 74% of commits, 78% of explores, 47% of verifies - the weakest class is the one C030/C031 depend on, so a ~200-call hand-label pass is the first step.
false_positive_risk: Medium for verify vs implement (write+run commands, python3/cat/mkdir first tokens); explore vs write is the easy split.
evidence_refs: src: BO-24 | PH-00; PH-01; PH-02; PH-05; RULE-A05; ING-02; T07; T08

trigger: NOW class: queue-operation enqueue with content, or queued_command with commandMode=='prompt' and origin.kind=='human', during a running turn; retires on the remove (absorbed_mid_turn / delivered) or dequeue, or at turn end; task-notification commandMode counted separately; promptSource=='queued' lines = delivered at turn start.
data_sources: queue-operation {operation, reason, content} (operation parsed at usage.rs:250; reason ignored), attachment queued_command {commandMode, origin.kind, prompt, timestamp} (unparsed), user.promptSource; agg.queued_prompts (in State, counts machine notifications too - the existing metric keeps the total).
user_action: Decide between waiting for the next API call (cheap) and Esc (stops the running tool); avoid stacking several steers that land at once.

title: Scope drift: paths touched this turn vs paths named in the prompt or plan
what: Turn line 'scope: 7 files in src/auth (prompt) · 4 reads outside (src/db, tests/)' and a coach cue after 4 consecutive out-of-scope edits: 'Claude is working outside the scope you gave - Esc and redirect, or queue: stay in src/auth'.

data_sources: user prompt text (path tokens only, in memory), attachment file/directory @-mentions, tool_use inputs and Bash command paths (C055), plan_file_reference.planContent / ~/.claude/plans/<slug>.md. Not in State.
user_action: Esc and redirect, or type a one-line scope reminder (queued, lands at the next API call).

title: Nudge slot policy: one nudge at a time, three urgency classes, retirement, cooldowns and suppression
what: Exactly one primary nudge (<= 2 lines x 58 chars) plus at most one 'soon' line. Every coach rule carries urgency: NOW (act within this turn: interrupt, denial streak, waiting, commit-without-check), NEXT (next boundary: checkpoint, switch window, cold resume, /clear), LATER (turn-end retrospectives: /btw, churn, serial calls, harness overhead). NOW pre-empts NEXT pre-empts LATER; within a class rank by token-calls saved = tokens x expected remaining calls. Retirement: (a) predicate false; (b) acted - each rule names an observable completion (Agent spawn after the explore nudge, a verify call after the no-check nudge, /clear after the checkpoint nudge, next human prompt after an interrupt nudge); (c) hard TTL: NOW dies at turn end, NEXT at the next human prompt, LATER after 3 turns. Cooldown per rule 5 turns; a nudge shown 3x unacted self-snoozes for the session (Claude Code's tip cooldownSessions pattern); x snooze persists to ~/.cctop/<session>.advisor.json so query/MCP/pane see the same state. Suppression: bot loops (C058), machine turns (promptSource system, origin.kind task-notification/scheduled-trigger), subagent transcripts, the first 2 turns, away > 2 h (nudges expire silently; only the resume nudge survives). Budget: max 1 new nudge per turn, ~6 per hour. Never duplicate Claude Code's own footer (context-low, auto-continue at limit, effort-downgrade dialog).
trigger: Engine-level: applies to every coach rule on the advisor tick; a nudge is promoted from the ranked list only when its class beats the current one or the current one retired.
data_sources: Advice struct (src/advisor/mod.rs) gains urgency, since_turn, window_turns, acted predicate; Engine.dismissed persisted to ~/.cctop/<session>.advisor.json (in-memory only today; Engine rebuilt per CLI call); suppression inputs: hook_blocking_error count (new parse), promptSource/origin.kind (new parse), agg.turns started_at (in State), last_line_at_ms for away detection (in State).
user_action: Reads one line, acts or presses x; never triages a list.
benefit_estimate: Prevents the audit's advisor failure mode: session-lifetime rules (A03/A04/A05/A10/A11/A15) never retire and one big incident pins the top slot; Avoids-ranked rules (A06/A13/A18) pin forever. With retirement + acted-detection the coach line changes when the person acts. 760 turns/month, so a 1-per-turn budget caps the coach at ~760 lines/month vs 18 rules x every tick.
false_positive_risk: Medium: acted predicates can misfire (an Agent spawned for another reason retires the explore nudge) - mitigated by also retiring on predicate-false; cooldowns hide a genuinely repeated problem - the strip numbers (C041) still show it.
evidence_refs: src: COACH-02 | RULE-ENGINE; RULE-A03; RULE-A18; QUERY-01; BIN-32; F16; RW-19; T13; T01(anatomy); PH-14

title: Side question in a big context: /btw next time
what: 'side question in a 412k context (1 call, no tools) - $0.21 -> next time /btw: the answer stays out of history'.
trigger: LATER class at turn end: human prompt is question-shaped (ends with '?' or starts with what|how|why|where|which|is|does|kann|wie|warum), the turn made 1 API call with zero tool calls, ctx > 100k. At most once per 20 turns; dies after 2 turns; cooldown lowered once history.jsonl shows /btw use in the project.
data_sources: agg.turns prompt_chars/api_calls/tool_calls (in State; a prompt-shape flag computed at parse time, no stored text), ctx (in State), pricing; ~/.claude/history.jsonl /btw count (15 lifetime).
user_action: Use /btw for the next quick question instead of a normal prompt.
benefit_estimate: Answer-only turns are 31% of turns (233/760) and add p50 730 tokens each - small once, but re-read on every later call (~106x); at 400k ctx the question itself costs a full re-read ($0.21 opus-5). Distinct from A12 (chatty tiny prompts by rate).
false_positive_risk: Medium: not every question is a side question (some are the task); keep rare and only above 100k ctx.
evidence_refs: src: COACH-21 | P18; HS-06; BIN-31; BIN-38; SUG-LONGRUN-PLAN-ANSWER; PH-11; T01(anatomy)
